definitions.full: H3191. yetab [ יְטַב ] verb be (good,) pleasing ( ᵑ7 ; Egyptian Aramaic Haf. הוטב S-C B11 +; see Biblical Hebrew יטב ); — Pe`al Imperfect יֵיטַב (K § 43, 2 ) Ezra 7:18 ( עַל person, + infinitive).
